_readme: Cases for render_test.py. Ids: I = image, V = video (V10a-c are the 3 clips behind stitched V10). tier: smoke < standard < full. 'standard' is the requested set: 10 images + 10 videos, each video 10-15 s. 'full' adds 4 optional extras. needs = another case whose final output becomes image_start (image-to-video). kind 'stitch' joins 'parts' with ffmpeg. internal = a sub-clip, not a deliverable.

cases.name: I01_ghibli_traveler
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Structured Ghibli scene. Keyframe for V01.

settings.prompt: Studio Ghibli-style painterly illustration, warm semi-realistic anime fantasy art. Subject: a lone young man seen from behind in a three-quarter angle, messy brown hair, a sword strapped to his back, wearing a worn turquoise tunic with a brown belt and a travel cloak lifted slightly by the wind, standing on top of an old crumbling mossy stone wall. Setting: a vast green valley opens in front of him. On the left, far in the distance, a small stone castle sits on a hill. On the right and further below the wall, a modest village of thatched roofs with thin smoke rising. Straight ahead at eye level, a massive snow-capped mountain range meets a dramatic sky of soft cumulus clouds, a winding dirt road curling through the rolling hills. Composition: natural wide-angle view with strong depth: foreground wall stones, midground valley, distant mountains. Lighting: golden-hour sun low behind the peaks, warm rim light on the cloak, long soft shadows. Palette: muted greens, earthy browns and golds, a glowing sky in soft orange and pale blue. Style: hand-painted gouache texture, visible brushwork, cinematic depth, classic anime movie aesthetic, no photorealism. No text, no watermark.

cases.name: I02_sneaker_product
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Hard surface and material realism. Keyframe for V02.

settings.prompt: Premium studio product photograph of a white-and-orange running sneaker standing on a matte grey circular pedestal against a seamless soft grey gradient backdrop. A single large soft key light from the upper left with a crisp rim light along the mesh upper, a faint glossy reflection of the sole on the floor, macro-level detail on the stitching, breathable mesh texture and the translucent foam midsole, shallow depth of field, 85 mm lens, clean commercial look, muted neutral palette with one vivid orange accent, no text, no logo.

cases.name: I03_neon_street_text
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Text rendering ('OPEN 24 HOURS' spelling) + reflections. Keyframe for V03.

settings.prompt: Cinematic night street in a rain-soaked small Asian city. A glowing pink neon sign above a noodle-shop door reads exactly "OPEN 24 HOURS" in clean neon letters. Wet asphalt reflects pink and cyan light, a person in a dark coat walks past holding a yellow umbrella, a yellow taxi waits at the kerb with its headlights glowing softly, thin rain streaks catch the neon light, steam rising from a street-food stall, shallow depth of field, 35 mm lens, moody teal-and-magenta colour grading, photorealistic.

cases.name: I04_weathered_sailor_portrait
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Faces, skin, eyes, hands. Image only (no video).

settings.prompt: Close-up cinematic portrait of a weathered woman sailor in her fifties, deep-set grey eyes, salt-and-pepper hair tied back with loose strands blowing in the wind, a faint scar across the left eyebrow, a navy wool collar, soft overcast light from a window on her right, natural skin texture with fine pores and sun lines, shallow depth of field, 85 mm lens, muted tones, photorealistic.

cases.name: I05_father_braids_hair
cases.note: PASTED (ai.multhouse). Pixar/DreamWorks 3D look. Keyframe for V05.

settings.prompt: Pixar-style 3D CGI animated film still, medium close-up. A gentle father in his early thirties with short, slightly tousled brown hair and a warm, patient, slightly puzzled expression, wearing a simple brown cotton t-shirt, kneels behind his cute toddler daughter and carefully tries to braid her long, silky blonde hair, a few loose strands already escaping between his big fingers. The toddler, about two years old, with round rosy cheeks and big bright blue eyes, sits cross-legged on a soft pastel rug in a cozy, brightly lit children's bedroom, wearing light pink pajamas with tiny star prints, absorbed in playing with a small plush doll she holds in both hands. Warm morning sunlight streams through a window on the left, creating soft rim light on the golden hair strands; the background is softly out of focus with pastel striped wallpaper, scattered plush toys, a wooden toy chest and a small bookshelf. Smooth stylised character modelling, expressive eyes, subsurface scattering on skin, finely detailed individually lit hair strands, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, rich warm colour grading, 3D animated feature-film quality.

cases.name: I06_dog_taxi_driver
cases.note: PASTED (bark__laugh_). Photoreal animals with props. Keyframe for V06.

settings.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic wide shot inside a vintage New York yellow taxi cab. A funny black Labrador sits upright in the driver seat acting as the taxi driver, wearing a yellow vintage taxi cap, classic aviator sunglasses and a buttoned yellow driver's uniform shirt with a collar, both front paws resting on the large steering wheel. In the front passenger seat, a brown golden-retriever-mix dog sits upright with a curious expression, looking around. Realistic fur texture with individual hairs catching the light, warm natural daylight streaming through the windshield, detailed taxi interior with dashboard, fare meter, seatbelt and yellow cab trim, a softly blurred city street with moving traffic seen through the windows, 35 mm photograph look, shot on a full-frame camera, natural colours.

cases.name: I07_baby_lawyer_court
cases.note: PASTED (ai_babay_funland). Photoreal child + cultural setting + crowd. Keyframe for V07.

settings.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic wide shot inside a traditional Indian courtroom. A cute chubby-cheeked toddler boy aged two, wearing a miniature sharp dark navy business suit, a white collared shirt and a black necktie, stands on a small wooden step stool in front of the judge's high carved wooden bench, one tiny hand raised as if making a point. Behind the bench a senior judge in black robes looks down at the baby with a warm smile. In the softly blurred background: lawyers in black coats and white bands, a uniformed police officer and audience members seated on wooden benches. Polished wooden textures, warm ambient light mixed with soft overhead fluorescents, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth of field, 35 mm lens, natural colours.

cases.name: I08_ai_avatar_presenter
cases.note: PASTED (vaibhavsisinty). The AVATAR example: this fictional person is generated first, then made to talk in V08.

settings.prompt: Photorealistic vertical medium shot of a friendly, energetic male tech content creator in his early thirties with short dark hair and a neat short beard, wearing a plain black t-shirt, seated at a desk in a modern dark-themed studio. Soft cyan and orange neon accent lights glow behind him, a warm key light on his face, a blurred monitor and shelf with small gadgets in the background. He looks straight into the camera with a confident half-smile, relaxed shoulders, hands resting on the desk. Professional short-form video framing with headroom, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin detail, shallow depth of field, 35 mm lens.

cases.name: I09_ganesha_mushak_army
cases.note: PASTED (yogesh_bhusare). Many small characters, ornate details, 3D CGI. Keyframe for V09.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D CGI render, wide-angle hero shot, Pixar-style character design. A cute, majestic young Lord Ganesha walks forward in a grand ancient stone temple courtyard, wearing an ornate gold crown, jewelled ornaments and a vibrant silk dhoti. Marching behind and beside him is a large, orderly army of adorable tiny anthropomorphic 3D mice (Mushaks) in small saffron wraps and traditional headbands, some carrying tiny flags and drums. Divine golden volumetric light rays break through the clouds, flower petals and soft dust particles float in the air, hyper-detailed fabric and metal textures, warm festive colour palette, shallow depth of field, reverent and joyful atmosphere.

cases.name: I10_toddler_sleepy_bedroom
cases.note: PASTED (toddler prompt). The ONE image behind the kids' blood story: V10a, V10b and V10c all start from it.

settings.prompt: Pixar-style 3D render of a cute toddler lying on a cozy bed in a softly lit rustic bedroom, vibrant wallpaper with rabbit and mushroom illustrations. The toddler is wearing patterned pajamas, lying down with heavy sleepy eyes, one small hand resting on the blanket. Warm indoor lamp lighting, shallow depth of field, high detail, volumetric ambient light, smooth CGI textures, cinematic colour grading.

cases.name: V01_ghibli_traveler_10s
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Image-to-video from I01.

settings.prompt: The painted Ghibli scene comes to life. The young man's turquoise tunic and cloak ripple in a steady breeze, he slowly turns his head to look across the valley and takes one calm step forward on the wall. Clouds drift slowly across the sky, thin smoke rises and sways from the village chimneys, grass on the hills ripples in waves, a few birds cross the sky. The camera starts static, then performs a slow, gentle push-in over ten seconds. Warm golden-hour light, painterly gouache texture preserved, hand-drawn animation feel. Audio: steady wind, distant birdsong, a soft solo flute melody, faint cloth flutter.

cases.name: V02_sneaker_ad_10s
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Rigid object, controlled motion, reflections. Image-to-video from I02.

settings.prompt: Premium product commercial. The white-and-orange running sneaker rotates slowly and smoothly clockwise on the grey pedestal. A single soft key light sweeps from left to right across the sneaker, creating a moving highlight along the mesh upper and a crisp reflection on the glossy floor. The camera performs a smooth low-angle orbit, then glides in to a macro close-up of the stitching and sole texture, then pulls back. Seamless backdrop, no wobble, rigid object, clean commercial look. Audio: a subtle rising synth whoosh, a soft click as the light settles, a clean low bass pulse.

cases.name: V03_neon_street_rain_10s
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). Reflections, several moving subjects, ambient audio. Image-to-video from I03.

settings.prompt: The rainy neon street comes alive. Rain falls steadily and streaks through the pink and cyan neon light. The person with the yellow umbrella walks calmly from right to left past the noodle shop, ripples spread in the puddles, the yellow taxi at the kerb pulls away slowly with wipers moving and its tail-lights flaring softly. Steam drifts up from the food stall. Smooth slow dolly-back, shallow depth of field, neon reflections shimmer on the wet asphalt. The neon sign stays legible. Audio: steady rain, tyres splashing, a muffled traffic hum, a distant siren, a faint electric buzz from the neon.

cases.name: V04_waterfall_nature_10s
cases.note: MY EXAMPLE (kept). TEXT-to-video (no image): the t2v reference for comparing with the image-to-video cases. Fluids, particles.

settings.prompt: Nature-documentary shot of a tall forest waterfall plunging into a turquoise pool, ferns and wet mossy rocks in the foreground, mist drifting through shafts of morning sunlight between the trees. The camera slowly tilts up from the pool to the top of the falls over ten seconds. The water flows smoothly and continuously, droplets sparkle, leaves sway gently, a dragonfly crosses the foreground. Natural colours, crisp detail, 35 mm cinematic look. Audio: the deep roar of falling water, light birdsong, distant rustling leaves.

cases.name: V05_father_braids_hair_12s
cases.note: PASTED (ai.multhouse). Image-to-video from I05. Watch hands and hair physics.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D CGI animation, slow subtle camera drift to the right. The father gently gathers three sections of his daughter's blonde hair and clumsily crosses them over each other, his eyebrows knitting in concentration, then he pauses and tilts his head with a puzzled smile as a strand slips loose. The toddler sways a little from side to side, giggles, makes her small doll hop in her hands and glances up at her dad with a cheeky grin. Natural hair physics, soft eye blinks, small breathing motion, warm sunlight shifting softly. Audio: the toddler's soft giggles, the father's low amused hum, quiet fabric rustles, faint birds outside the window, a gentle playful ukulele melody.

cases.name: V06_dog_taxi_driver_10s
cases.note: PASTED (bark__laugh_). Image-to-video from I06. Animal motion and props staying on the dogs.

settings.prompt: Cinematic live-action video, subtle handheld camera movement inside a moving taxi cab. The black Labrador driver slightly turns its head toward the passenger while wearing the aviator sunglasses, panting gently with a relaxed expression, one paw adjusting on the steering wheel. The golden retriever passenger blinks, tilts its head and glances at the driver. Soft background motion blur through the windows as the taxi drives down a city street, light and shadow from passing buildings sweep across the dashboard. Photorealistic, natural fur motion. Audio: engine hum, soft city traffic, a quiet fare-meter tick, a short friendly dog huff.

cases.name: V07_baby_lawyer_speaks_12s
cases.note: PASTED (ai_babay_funland). Image-to-video from I07 with SPOKEN dialogue: listen for lip sync.

settings.prompt: Realistic live-action video inside the courtroom, subtle handheld camera movement. The toddler in the suit gestures animatedly with tiny hands and says in a small, confident voice: "Your Honour, my client only wants ten more minutes of cartoons." He raises his head toward the judge as he speaks. The senior judge nods slightly and breaks into a warm chuckle; a ripple of amusement runs through the people in the background. Natural blinks, clear mouth movement matching the words, soft depth of field. Audio: the toddler's clear speech, the judge's chuckle, low murmurs and light laughter, a ceiling-fan hum, one soft tap of a wooden gavel.

cases.name: V08_ai_avatar_speaks_15s
cases.note: PASTED (vaibhavsisinty). THE AVATAR EXAMPLE: image-to-video from I08, 15 s of speech, 9:16. Listen for lip sync and clarity.

settings.prompt: A realistic AI digital presenter speaks directly to the camera in a fast, energetic tech-influencer tone. He says: "Stop paying twenty dollars a month for every AI tool. Pick an open model, grab a free test key, paste it into your editor, and you're running in minutes. Link in bio." Natural lip sync, subtle head tilts and nods, authentic eye blinks, two quick hand gestures for emphasis, natural breathing. Static camera with a very slight push-in, steady lighting, the cyan and orange neon glow flickering softly behind him. Audio: his clear voice, a quiet upbeat electronic music bed.

cases.name: V09_ganesha_mushak_march_12s
cases.note: PASTED (yogesh_bhusare). Image-to-video from I09. Many small characters moving in step.

settings.prompt: Epic cinematic 3D animation, slow-motion tracking camera moving backward in front of the procession. Lord Ganesha walks forward with a gentle, confident smile. The army of tiny mice marches in step, bobbing their heads and moving their feet smoothly, flags swaying. Floating golden light rays, soft flower petals gently falling around them, fabric and ornament motion natural. Audio: festive dhol drums, temple bells, soft footsteps, a distant gentle conch.

cases.name: V10a_blood_story_a_toddler_5s
cases.note: PASTED (toddler motion prompt). Clip 1 of 3, image-to-video from I10.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation, subtle slow-motion camera drift. The toddler slowly yawns, eyelids drooping sleepily. The toddler gently sways and rocks side to side on the bed in a continuous self-soothing motion, smoothly breathing. Soft warm ambient glow, fluid character movement, seamless 3D CGI motion. cases.name: V10b_blood_story_b_red_cells_5s
cases.note: NEW (kids health). Clip 2 of 3 from the SAME image I10: does image-to-video go 'inside the body'? Exploratory.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation for children. The camera glides slowly toward the sleeping toddler's small hand resting on the blanket; the skin turns softly transparent in a friendly, glowing cartoon way, revealing a warm-lit blood vessel. Round, smiling cartoon red blood cells float along in single file, carrying tiny glowing blue oxygen bubbles, bobbing and spinning gently. Soft magical glow, kid-safe, no gore. Audio: a calm friendly narrator says: "Red blood cells carry oxygen all around your body." Soft heartbeat rhythm and gentle chimes.

cases.name: V10c_blood_story_c_white_cells_platelets_5s
cases.note: NEW (kids health). Clip 3 of 3 from the SAME image I10. Exploratory.

settings.prompt: Cinematic 3D animation for children, continuing inside the same glowing blood vessel. Big friendly white blood cells in cartoon guard uniforms bounce toward a small, grumpy green germ and gently pop it with a puff of sparkles, while tiny star-shaped platelets stick together to patch a little scrape on the vessel wall. Soft magical glow, kid-safe, no gore. Audio: a calm friendly narrator says: "White blood cells protect you from germs, and platelets fix cuts." Gentle chimes and a soft heartbeat.

settings.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic in dark red and charcoal grey on a light background, a segmented flowchart titled "How to Start a Start-Up". Crisp lines, consistent icon style, professional design.
